title: World-stage empire
kicker: World and empire · where you stand
hook: **Vision:** the finished place you stand to run the empire — one camera, corner HUD, loam strip, calendar, inspector — not a flowchart with a sidebar of buttons. Not finished / not playable yet as that place.

blindSpots.meaning: Locked design. The full empire stage as a finished place is not what you open today.
Where you **are** when you run the empire — distinct from the adventure graph where you **go**.
What ships today: graph, movement, End Turn. Useful, but not the finished stage fantasy.
A surface over the map for holdings and details — part of the stage HUD fantasy, not a separate wiki.

alsoTrue: Same virtual-turn clock as the adventure graph — End Turn still commits everyone’s orders.
Sector buildings and recruitment harden into this place as WIP / Vision pieces land.

sections.title: Not finished / not playable yet
paras: You play a thin map surface today. You do not yet stand in the finished empire place.
Read this page for the intended feel — then use [world map](world-map) and [virtual turns](virtual-turns) for live play.

sections.title: What it is (design)
paras: One camera. Corner HUD. Loam strip. Calendar. Inspector over the map.
Inside a held sector: slots, buildings, recruitment, upkeep, wardens. Neglect makes the Fracture real.
diagram: sectors / lanes / fog  ->  HUD / inspector / buildings

groups.title: Thin surface
groups.intro: Graph and End Turn are playable.
steps: Travel to World and march as you do now.
Do not hunt for a finished stage HUD — it is Vision.
Watch for WIP buildings and tools as they harden toward this place.
groups.note: Full empire stage as the place you stand stays Vision.

doTitle: What you do with this page
doSteps: Play the shipped world map without waiting on a finished stage chrome.
Treat missing inspector / recruitment game as Vision / WIP, not a broken install.
When you want construction fantasy, read [sector buildings](sector-buildings) as the farm beat that feeds this place.
doNote: Stop when stage ≠ flowchart page. Live clock: [virtual turns](virtual-turns).

mixUps.q: Is World travel the finished stage?
mixUps.a: No. Travel opens the thin graph. Finished stage place is Vision.

mixUps.q: Does the stage use a diary calendar?
mixUps.a: Design shows a calendar in the HUD fantasy; time still resolves on virtual turns, not a real-life meta-clock.
Buildings are WIP; the finished stage place is Vision.

mixUps.q: Is this a different clock from the map?
mixUps.a: No. Same End Turn / virtual turns.
